skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and simplifying when needed.

skills.name: Find common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Align and subtract the whole-number parts of mixed or whole-number expressions when the fractional part of the minuend is sufficient.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole-number part and rename it as a fraction when the minuend's fractional part is too small or absent.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert mixed numerals that contain improper fractional parts into equivalent standard mixed numbers before subtracting.
